title: field_ops.sla.breached v1
description: Emitted when a field order crosses its SLA target and a SlaBreachLog row with event='breached' is inserted. This is the event_type the producer stamps today: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher maps the [:alebrije_field_ops, :sla, :breached] telemetry event (Slas.log_event) to 'field_ops.sla.breached', and build_envelope/3 nests every field under `data`. The older field_ops.sla.breach.v1.json documents the alias that agentic also subscribes to; agentic accepts both names.

order_id.description: field_orders row the event is about (UUID).

sla_id.description: Sla definition the order is measured against (UUID).

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.
